preconditions.description: Input constraints: n (vertices) is at least 2, m (edges) is at least 1, and q (queries) is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai < bi <= n for ai, bi, ci in edges) and all(1 <= ci <= m for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (ai, bi, ci) has valid vertex indices (1 ≤ ai < bi ≤ n) and color index (1 ≤ ci ≤ m).

preconditions.expression: len(set((ai, bi, ci) for ai, bi, ci in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: No duplicate edges of the same color between the same pair of vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui != vi <= n for ui, vi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query (ui, vi) has valid vertex indices (1 ≤ ui, vi ≤ n) and ui ≠ vi.

postconditions.description: Output contains exactly one line per query.
Each output line is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output_lines[i]) <= m for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each output is a valid color count (0 ≤ answer ≤ m).

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == len(set(color for color in colors if connected_by_color(ui, vi, color, edges))) for i, (ui, vi) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query (ui, vi), the output is the number of distinct colors for which ui and vi are connected (directly or indirectly) by edges of that color.
